The Baby Alien Club™️ is a 2-part CNFT series where you can FUSE Series 1 with Series 2 to form 1 unique CNFT. Like us, they eat, play and most of all, laugh. They love having fun & getting into mischief.

Only 10,000 will be minted for the first series. 30 of the 10,000 will be reserved for community giveaways.
